sketchyicons
============

bowing its straight runs and drifting its coordinates, so the drawn paths are a
derivative work of Lucide and keep Lucide's terms. Lucide is ISC licensed,

their name, not ours.

notices are reproduced in full below, as both licences require.

sketchyicons is not affiliated with Feather either.
